name: Village of Briarcliff Manor
gaps: Required yards depend on house size: recorded front/side/rear are for houses with gross floor area <= 3,500 sf; larger-house yards are in each district's notes.
No impervious/development coverage limit or lot depth in Table 2. R80A has no building coverage limit ('—').
R30M entry uses the single-family row; R30M multifamily standards in notes. Table 2 column 7 (blank heading, '5' for R30M multifamily) not interpreted.
EC height and coverage not found in § 220-21A excerpts read.
County layer lot sizes differ for R60A (40,000) and R80A (60,000); Table 2 values (60,000 / 80,000) used. L.L. 10-2024 is titled as amending Table 2 but its attached table is Table 4 (commercial).
Corner-lot street side yard (40 ft, Table 5) recorded as corner_side_ft for every district.

wetlands.summary: Ch. 218: wetlands, watercourses and a 100 ft buffer area around them are regulated; draining, filling, excavation, building and similar regulated activities need a wetland permit.

steep_slopes.summary: § 220-15: Planning Board steep-slope approval to disturb slopes of 15%+ covering 10,000 sf or more (min 10 ft dimension), unless the Board finds no off-parcel impact. Slopes over 25% are deducted from buildable area for special permits.

trees.summary: Ch. 202: permit for clearing (10+ trees >= 7 in. DBH per 10,000 sf in 12 months), removing more than 2 trees >= 7 in. DBH per year in the landscape buffer or regulated setback zone, any significant tree, or trees >= 4 in. DBH on 15-25% slopes.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 184: SWPPP for land development disturbing 1 acre or more.

adu.summary: § 220-9.2: dwelling units allowed only in accessory buildings that existed on 7-1-2014, in R80A, R60A, R40A and R40B, one per lot; no general accessory-apartment provision found.

general.accessory_structures: Table 2 cols 12-15 give reduced accessory setbacks only for accessory buildings <= 150 sf (<= 300 sf in R10B/R12B); larger ones follow principal rules. Accessory buildings 15 ft (sloping roof) / 12 ft (flat). On corner lots accessory buildings keep the front-yard depth from the side street (Table 5, 2(d)).
general.pools: § 220-9: one pool per lot, only on lots of 30,000 sf+; rear or side yard, 5 ft from the house, 20 ft from rear and 40 ft from side lot lines, 100 ft from any street, max 6% of lot area; no bubbles.
general.notes: Fences: solid max 4 ft in front yards, 6 ft in side/rear yards (Table 1 accessory use 10). Corner sight triangle 25 ft.

R80A.name: R80A Single-Family Residence

max_floor_area.note: Table 2 note 3: max gross floor area of all buildings for single-family use; site plan approval needed above 10,000 sf total (note 4).

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings under 150 sf: 40 ft from street line, 25 ft from side and 14 ft from rear lot lines, 12 ft from the principal building; 15 ft high (sloping roof) or 12 ft (flat). Larger accessory buildings are measured as principal buildings (Table 2 note 2).

R80A.source: § 220-4, Table 2 Permitted Lot Sizes, Setbacks, Height Requirements (Residential) (Attachment 2, Supp 32 Mar 2025); Table 5 (Exceptions and Modifications) 2(e)
R80A.notes: Table 2 sets no building coverage limit for R80A ('—'). Houses over 3,500 sf gross floor area need larger yards: front 65, one side 40, both sides 80, rear 60 ft (Table 2 cols 8A-11A); recorded yards are for houses of 3,500 sf or less. Lot width measured at the front yard setback. Front yard may be reduced to the average of adjoining dwellings (Table 5, 2(b)); corner-lot street side yard min 40 ft (Table 5, 2(e)).
